title: AI feature release
description: Readiness for shipping a feature that uses a language model: evaluation, failure behaviour, prompt injection, data handling, cost and latency limits, human oversight, and disclosure.
advisory: Engineering checklist. Regulatory obligations for AI systems vary by jurisdiction and use; review against the applicable law and provider terms. Passing it is not a safety certification.

questions.text: Can the model call tools or take actions (write data, send messages, run code)?
Does untrusted content (user input, documents, web pages) reach the prompt?
Is personal data sent to a model provider?
Do outputs affect decisions about people (eligibility, hiring, credit, health)?
Is model output shown directly to end users?

criteria.title: Evaluation set with recorded baseline
criteria.expected: A versioned, reviewed evaluation set exists; baseline results are recorded with model and prompt versions.

task.title: Build an evaluation set and record a baseline
task.description: Create a reviewed evaluation set and record baseline results with versions.

criteria.title: Release thresholds met
criteria.expected: Agreed quality thresholds, chosen before tuning on held-out cases, are met by the release candidate.

task.title: Run the held-out evaluation against thresholds
task.description: Run the release candidate on held-out cases and compare with thresholds.

criteria.title: Provider failures degrade safely
criteria.expected: Timeouts, rate limits, refusals and malformed output produce a defined fallback, not a crash or a fabricated answer.

task.title: Test provider failure handling
task.description: Inject timeouts, rate limits, refusals and malformed output; check fallbacks.

criteria.title: Prompt injection tested
criteria.expected: Injected instructions in untrusted content do not change behaviour or grant capabilities.

verification.method: Red-team cases in the evaluation set.

task.title: Add prompt-injection test cases
task.description: Add injected instructions to untrusted inputs and verify behaviour.

criteria.title: Tool calls are permissioned
criteria.expected: Actions with side effects require explicit permission or confirmation; tools run with least privilege.

verification.method: Review of tool definitions plus tests of refused actions.

task.title: Review tool permissions
task.description: Check side-effecting tools require confirmation and run with least privilege.

criteria.title: Provider data terms reviewed
criteria.expected: Data sent to the provider is minimised; retention and training terms are reviewed and documented. (Advisory.)

verification.method: Human review of provider terms and data flow.

task.title: Review provider data terms
task.description: Minimise data sent and document provider retention and training terms.

criteria.title: Cost and latency limits enforced
criteria.expected: Per-request timeouts and token/cost budgets are enforced and monitored; unknown pricing is reported as unknown.

task.title: Enforce cost and latency limits
task.description: Set timeouts and budgets, and monitor spend and latency.

criteria.title: Human review of high-impact outputs
criteria.expected: A person reviews or can contest model-assisted decisions about people. (Advisory: confirm legal obligations.)

task.title: Define human review for high-impact outputs
task.description: Ensure a person reviews or can contest model-assisted decisions.

criteria.title: AI use disclosed to users
criteria.expected: Users can tell when content is model-generated and how to report problems.

task.title: Disclose model-generated content
task.description: Label model output and provide a way to report problems.
